8-Servo Walker

Jul 2026 - Aug 2026
Arduino · C++ · Prototyping · Testing

An 8-servo walker that walks in a straight line. Includes a servo for the "hip" and "knee" in each limb, allowing for dynamic movement. Improvements were made to the body to maintain stability, and a battery was added so that the robot can move without being powered with a computer connection.
